sourceReview.reason: Rechecked original Banque de France full speech published 2026-11-03: Beau said private-sector clearing for tokenized bank deposits relying on Pontes 'could' be encouraged, not that a clearing layer, participants or launch had been announced. The original event is over seven days old as of 2026-11-11 and cannot satisfy source_review.py's seven-day source-publication window. Hold; do not turn a hypothetical into an announced project.
